description: PS5-style launcher for AnyPS5: finds PS5 game dumps, unlocks them with the AnyPS5 engine and starts them.
notes: The launcher's own update offer runs the Windows installer, which puts a second copy in
%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\AnyPS5 Desktop. To keep this copy current instead, turn off
Settings -> Behaviour -> Check for updates and run 'scoop update anyps5-desktop'.
Settings, logs, caches and engines stay in %APPDATA%\AnyPS5 and %LOCALAPPDATA%\AnyPS5.
